# Release notes

The newest release is first. In Odoo the version number starts with the Odoo version, so release 1.1.0 for Odoo 20.0 shows as `20.0.1.1.0`.

## 1.1.1

*2026-11-03, Odoo 17.0 - 20.0*

- Store page and app links now point to this user guide. No change to how the app works.

## 1.1.0

*2026-10-23, Odoo 17.0 - 20.0*

- Rewritten calculation engine with a day by day view.
- Several warehouses at once.
- Click through from the ledger to the document.
- Lots.
- Odoo 19.0 and 20.0 versions.

## 1.0.1

*2026-01-20, Odoo 17.0 - 18.0*

- The technical name changed to daily_stock_ledger.
